description: Search a company name across official registers in one call: France, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Czechia and Estonia, plus GLEIF LEI records for every other country. One ranked list: register ID, legal form, city, LEI, a link to the register's own page, time read. A source that does not answer is named; the rest still answer. Use for KYB, supplier and customer checks, and facts about a European company. Example: q=Spotify. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

country.description: Only these countries: ISO codes or names, comma-separated (FR, SE, NO, FI, CZ, EE search their registers; any other country searches GLEIF). Default: all

q.description: Company name, with or without the legal form (AB, Oy, SA, GmbH…)

name: company_search
title: Company search, EU official registers
